entry.title: BiFlow-VLA: Bimanual Vision-Language-Action Policies with Flow Matching
entry.summary: We present BiFlow-VLA, a vision-language-action model for bimanual manipulation trained with flow matching on 12k teleoperated demonstrations. On 10 real-world tasks with two 7-DoF arms, BiFlow-VLA improves success rate by 18 points over prior VLA baselines while running at 30 Hz. Code is available at https://github.com/example/biflow-vla.
entry.arxiv:comment: Accepted to CoRL 2026. Project page: https://example.github.io/biflow

entry.title: Latent World Models for Contact-Rich Assembly
entry.summary: We study whether latent world models can plan contact-rich assembly. Our model predicts future tactile and visual latents and is trained entirely in simulation. Experiments in simulation show 2x sample efficiency over model-free RL.

entry.title: Whole-Body Humanoid Teleoperation from a Single RGB Camera
entry.summary: We propose a low-cost teleoperation system that retargets human whole-body motion captured by a single RGB camera to a humanoid robot. We collect 500 demonstrations and train imitation policies that walk and manipulate boxes on a real humanoid.

entry.title: TactileDiff: Diffusion Policies with GelSight Feedback for In-Hand Reorientation
entry.summary: TactileDiff conditions a diffusion policy on high-resolution tactile images for in-hand object reorientation with a 16-DoF dexterous hand. Real-robot experiments on 20 unseen objects show 76% success.

entry.title: OpenNav-Bench: A Benchmark for Language-Guided Navigation in Homes
entry.summary: We release OpenNav-Bench, a benchmark of 3,000 language-guided navigation episodes across 60 scanned homes, and evaluate 12 foundation-model agents.

entry.title: Sim-to-Real Transfer of Agile Quadruped Parkour via Teacher-Student Distillation
entry.summary: We train a quadruped parkour policy in simulation with privileged information and distill it into a depth-based student. The policy transfers zero-shot to a real quadruped and climbs 0.5 m obstacles.

entry.title: Scaling Laws for Robot Foundation Models
entry.summary: We train 40 robot foundation models from 10M to 3B parameters on a mixture of 1M robot trajectories and find power-law scaling of success rate with data and model size.

entry.title: Safe Human-Robot Handover with Predictive Intent Models
entry.summary: We present a handover controller that predicts human intent from gaze and hand pose and adjusts robot motion to keep separation distance. A user study with 24 participants shows reduced handover time.

entry.title: Occupancy World Models for Autonomous Driving
entry.summary: We propose a 4D occupancy world model that forecasts scene evolution for autonomous driving and improves planning on nuScenes.

entry.title: pi-Next: A Generalist Robot Policy
entry.summary: We introduce a generalist vision-language-action policy trained on diverse robot data that performs long-horizon household tasks on multiple real robot embodiments.

entry.title: Diffusion Policy 2: Fast and Robust Visuomotor Policy Learning
entry.summary: We revisit diffusion-based visuomotor policies and propose a faster sampler that runs at 100 Hz on real robots while improving robustness.

entry.title: Learning Dexterous Grasping from Human Videos
entry.summary: We learn dexterous grasping policies from internet human videos by retargeting hand poses, achieving 60% grasp success on unseen objects with a real multi-fingered hand.
